mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apis ( item_id, environment_id, name, method, url, headers, query_parameters, form_parameters, file, selected_body_type, create_at ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{environmentId}, #{name}, #{method}, #{url}, #{headers}, #{queryParameters}, #{formParameters}, #{file}, #{selectedBodyType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, item_id AS itemId, environment_id AS environmentId, name AS name, method AS method, url AS url, headers AS headers, query_parameters AS queryParameters, form_parameters AS formParameters, file AS file, selected_body_type AS selectedBodyType, create_at AS createAt FROM apis WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT id AS id, item_id AS itemId, environment_id AS environmentId, name AS name, method AS method, url AS url, headers AS headers, query_parameters AS queryParameters, form_parameters AS formParameters, file AS file, selected_body_type AS selectedBodyType, create_at AS createAt FROM apis WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE apis SET name = #{name}, method = #{method}, url = #{url}, headers = #{headers}, query_parameters = #{queryParameters}, form_parameters = #{formParameters}, file = #{file}, selected_body_type = #{selectedBodyType}, create_at = #{createAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_usage (user_id, project_id, item_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{itemId})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.email, u.password, u.auto_save_use AS autoSaveUse, u.auto_save_time AS autoSaveTime, u.auto_save_term AS autoSaveTerm, u.auto_save_path AS autoSavePath, u.show_response AS showResponse, u.verified, u.social_provider AS socialProvider, au.item_id AS itemId, au.project_id AS projectId FROM users u INNER JOIN api_usage au ON u.id = au.user_id WHERE au.project_id = #{projectId}
